subject: Demo acceptance matrix & proposed pilot kickoff - NebulaWorks
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Romero <alex.romero@nebulaworks.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo acceptance matrix & proposed pilot kickoff - NebulaWorks

Hi Alex — great to meet earlier today. Thanks for walking us through the onboarding flow and the three sample queries you want the assistant to surface. Per our discussion, I’m attaching a lightweight acceptance matrix and a proposed PoC timeline so your team can review and confirm what success looks like.

High-level summary (from today’s demo):
- Scope: integrate Redwood Inference for customer-facing search + response generation for KB articles (approx. 6k docs).
- Goal: reduce average time-to-answer and improve relevance for guided flows.

Draft acceptance criteria (attached in acceptance_matrix.xlsx):
- Latency: end-to-end p95 < 350ms for single-request path (no large context).
- Throughput: support 50 concurrent interactive sessions (sustained).
- Quality: semantic similarity / relevance score >= 0.85 on the 50 query eval set we discussed.
- Safety / hallucination: false-positive rate for hallucinated facts < 2% on a 100-item prompt set.
- Data handling: session data retained for 30 days; option for VPC-only retention for regulated flows.

Proposed PoC timeline (attached poc_timeline.pdf):
- Week 0: scoping sign-off + access (you provide test dataset + evaluation queries).
- Week 1: Redwood provisions trial environment, demo model mapping, and baseline metrics.
- Week 2: Validation run, iterate prompts and cache profiles, run evaluation harness.
- Week 3: Compile results + joint review & decision.

Next steps I’m requesting:
1) Please review the acceptance matrix and mark any items you’d like adjusted (especially data residency and retention).
2) Confirm procurement contact so we can route a short scoping doc / SOW.
3) Proposed kickoff window: Tue 30 Mar — Thu 1 Apr (we can be flexible).

Attachments: acceptance_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), poc_timeline.pdf (PDF)

Thanks — I’ll be on standby to adjust the matrix after your feedback.

—
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

Redwood Inference — production-first LLM serving

Thanks Marcus — useful recap and I appreciate the clear timelines. A few quick notes after sharing this with the product team: 

1) Data residency: we need an option for EU-only residency for any PII-derived embeddings. Can you call this out explicitly in the matrix as a pass/fail item?
2) Quality bar: can you add an item for intent preservation on multi-turn flows (we'd like <10% drop-off in intent accuracy across 3-turn dialogues).
3) Security: please share SOC2 type II evidence and clarify whether audit logs (per-request) are available for the trial environment.

Procurement will pick this up but for contracting speed, can you also send a short scoping statement we can attach to our internal purchase request?

Alex
Alex Romero
Director, Product — NebulaWorks
